Every set in D2R-XL 2012 and the items that belong to it. Each set's page shows all of its pieces and the bonuses for wearing two or more of them. Click a column to sort it, or type in a table's search box to filter.

== Sets ==
{{#cargo_query:tables=Items
|fields=_pageName=Set,COUNT(*)=Items,MIN(lvlreq)=Lowest level,MAX(lvlreq)=Highest level
|where=quality='set'
|group by=_pageName
|order by=_pageName
|format=dynamic table
|limit=5000
|rows per page=25
}}

== Set items ==
{{#cargo_query:tables=Items
|fields=CONCAT('[[',_pageName,'#',name,'{{!}}',name,']]')=Item,_pageName=Set,base=Base,type=Type,lvlreq=Required level
|where=quality='set'
|order by=_pageName,name
|format=dynamic table
|limit=5000
|rows per page=25
}}
[[Category:Items]]
